sections.heading: AI Features
items: Video Reframing: Select a clip/video, and use LTX 2.3 Reframe video model to change the aspect ratio
Lip Sync: Select a video and audio and lip sync them with Veed Lip Sync model

sections.heading: Improved
items: Refund logs in generation history: You can now see the refund transaction details in the generation history
Custom Aspect Ratio: You can set a custom aspect ratio for your timeline
More controls in silence removal: You can control the silence threshold and padding via UI or agent
